question:
A # B means 'A is the father of B'

A @ B means 'A is the brother of B'

A & B means 'A is the son of B'

If H & I @ J # K @ L, then how is J related to L?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbol:

of B

 
 
 

 

 

 

 

 

**Given expression: **'H & I @ J # K @ L'

H is the son of I, I is the brother of J, J is the father of K and K is the brother of L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e271f6ab98717d152134ae47d199f6626b84f63a1963313a8a61d97b85714e7.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
